name: cutroom
description: A video studio for Claude Code: plans a script, builds references and an animatic, generates shots (Seedance 2.5 / Veo 3.1), pulls Creative Commons footage, renders motion graphics (Hyperframes, Manim, Motion Canvas, Blender), records an emotive voiceover (Gemini 3.8 TTS), scores music (ElevenLabs), assembles with OpenTimelineIO + ffmpeg, captions, critiques, upscales to 4K and publishes.
